title: RMIT Tech Camp 2026
content_markdown:
# RMIT Tech Camp 2026

## Event Overview

RMIT Tech Camp 2026 is a dynamic program designed for high school students across Vietnam who want to explore technology and make an impact through innovation.

## Key Dates

- Registration Deadline: 5pm, 6 June 2026
- Phase 1 (Online workshops): 8-9 June 2026
- Phase 2 (Group project challenge): 10-17 June 2026
- Project Submission Deadline: 5pm, 17 June 2026
- Phase 3 (Grand final and awards): 26 June 2026
- Overall Program Duration: 15 April - 26 June 2026

## Schedule & Location

- Time: 09:00am - 05:00pm
- Format: Online and on campuses
- Venues: RMIT Saigon South, RMIT Hanoi
- Language: English

## Program Highlights

Participants will explore three key areas:
- Generative AI and machine learning
- Embedded systems
- Cybersecurity

The program includes developing real-world projects with teammates and competing in final rounds.

## Key Benefits

The program offers participants the opportunity to learn and apply their knowledge, fully funded while exploring future-shaping areas, and to strengthen their portfolio and gain a meaningful edge when applying for university scholarships.

## Awards & Prizes

Total prize pool: VND 65,000,000+

- First Prize: VND 10,000,000 equivalent
- First Runner-up: VND 5,000,000 equivalent
- Second Runner-up: VND 3,000,000 equivalent
- Fourth Prize: VND 1,000,000 equivalent

All participants who submit a final project receive a completion certificate.

## Platinum Partners

- Amazon Web Services (AWS)
- Google
- Megazone Cloud

## Contact

Official Email: techcamp@rmit.edu.vn
Facebook Community: RMIT Tech Camp Gen II Community
Cost: No participation fee required
